steps.job: The owner's answers to the 7 questions in section 5 (or the stated defaults), and the verdict-with-confidence method for A1 written as a short method note in the PR description.
The 15 decision stubs as nodes of the design (a developer revision with its sources, unsigned): current choice, options with evidence from the audits, owner team.
TS11 first: the golden table (results/golden.json), the tool that re-flies all 48 scenarios and compares, the CI job. Every later step then shows what it moved.

The flight runtime's tick and the failing-test rig: gyro_fail, reset, clock-step and jitter faults (engine, twin, C and Rust tick tests), F3 integer ticks, F1 monotonic bounded clock and carried epoch, F10 claim.
The gyro chain, design and tick together (fsw_modes, fsw_estimation, steplaws): F2/G3, F5, G4.
The estimator start, allocation and gains: F4, G1 (fsw_estimation), G2 (fsw_allocation), G6 with its step-response test (fswrw, fswmtq).
The device models: M1, M5, M2 (act_rotor_set), M9, M10 (sens and run schedule), engine and twin.
Power and sizing: Y2, Y4, Y5 (sizerotor, sizedemand), then Y1 (sensor power per mode in the run and in the static budget).
A5 inertia dispersion in both draws (engine and twin).
The verdicts: A7 windows (kpi), A1 evaluate and trace on one verdict function, A3 cause table, A2 ledger text and the 100-draw two-sample run (as a command; the long run is S11.16).
E6: m3_3 and gd_1 take the DTM2020 bundle (low, mean, high) from env, spec text off NRLMSIS, with a vector case; E1: the parity tool compares field, Sun and nadir directions.
P5: cap the orbit step at 30 s, refusal test.
Soft OILS hardening, first half: O2, O12 (check in CI), O19, O20, O21.
O11: bus-level fault injection for soft OILS (NACK, CRC, stuck register, delay, brownout).
TS17: replace the weak oracles; audit every test for the same pattern and list what was changed.

Regenerate (pcode.py gen, engine_build.py gen), the parity gates (twin-parity, fsw-parity), reseal the flight images, re-fly the cases that moved (a long twin re-fly goes to a watch step), the 100-draw A2 campaign, refresh the golden table.
Counts and tables: results/HEALTH.md, the ledger, ENGINE_PARITY and ENGINE_CAMPAIGNS regenerated, the zip 1.x corrected conversion for the drive.
The phase review: every fix has its failing test, source and comparison on its revision; the owner's list for S20.
